repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Contributor dev-loop and testing guides move from Cursor to .agents; they are separate from first-party runtime skills.

repository_updates.summary_zh: 158个已分发技能均只新增metadata.tags（关键词/学科标签）；逐文件去标签字段后全文严格相同，没有新增正文、算法、流程、依赖或权限。固定marketplace逐路径包含全部158项，公开技能集合仍281。根及已选嵌套MIT许可blob不变，出版商模板和第三方素材仍按自身条款。

repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Lesson creation and differentiation add Design/Docs delivery with a shared content baseline and synchronized revisions, retaining Word fallback.

repository_updates.summary_zh: peripheral pitfalls由11类61扩25类148，新增DMA/USB/Flash/RTC/ETH等及bigram；新增离线标准库timing-calc 37计算器输出公式/合法性，明确I2C Hs电流源模式不支持；register lookup/verify只有作者与patch version变化。

repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Contributor E2E scenario coverage is maintained separately from the public TrueSheet usage skill.

repository_updates.summary_zh: docs/drive/files/html/loop/messaging/summary同步OCTO_TOKEN优先及legacy alias，显式profile优先；doc/sheet import是原子replace不append，file download返回presigned URL JSON而非bytes、upload type/path为query，html list支持page而comment list当前一次全量；event loop改父shell process substitution保留cursor，Loop scope与schema校准。

repository_updates.summary_zh: MCP/tools入口同步mail线程与fenced advisory claims，收件是同事请求不等于用户授权，禁止向对方pane送keys；renew/release必须确切原fence，worker exit不使租约失效。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: MCP and tool guides add threaded mail and exact-fence advisory claims without treating peer messages as user authorization.

repository_updates.summary_zh: 内部helm-dev说明shared supervisor已从占位变真实assignment stream：TLS/JWT签名、受限token Secret读写/续期与health listener；新增internal release-captain的qualified pre-release→approved promotion→next-train维护流程，sync路由相应补齐，snap canary补prover alias。均属维护，不计公开4技能。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Internal guides document real shared-supervisor authentication and the release-captain process; public skill count is unaffected.

repository_updates.summary_zh: backend using-ao补session history以继承完整conversation；cloud using-ao从禁browser改支持AO Browser panel的open/snapshot/click等，是真产品运行时变体，应审内容但不把两份嵌入当独立技能。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Embedded runtime guides add conversation history and cloud Browser-panel operations without double-counting distribution copies.

repository_updates.summary_zh: 21入口整体压缩重写并统一每次调用deferred-schema发现和active-runtime能力。brownfield registry/find从DB读、只有scan走盘；cancel改MCP管project executions/jobs；run改start_execute_seed background与独占observer/同Seed chain；seed QA一次非阻断advisory、不自动循环改ontology，interview/PM human decisions与code/data evidence分开，run/ralph Synapse只加性定向AC不改批准合同。evaluate mechanical才可grant、semantic/consensus可withhold；QA经验事实高于judge。maintain入口删除，setup/update守receipt/extras与模型pin，resume加--list避免非TTY失败。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Workflow guides add DB-backed repository discovery and MCP-owned cancellation; Seed QA is single-pass advisory, with explicit background and contract boundaries.

repository_updates.summary_zh: 8入口description从API词表改按用户任务路由；React/Vue运行态先读__DC__.controller/actions，schema用shouldReorder保留version新数据而shouldUpdate只是省工；setup写AGENTS并从既有CLAUDE引用，Windows symlink/首次加载说明修订；testing/manager/rest入口职责文字更清楚。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Task-oriented routing, live store inspection, version-aware reordering and AGENTS-based setup replace several API-list descriptions.

repository_updates.summary_zh: PHP generator说明discriminated union按mapping目标hydrate，无独立class的plain oneOf保留raw array；Python aliases须在类和依赖aliases之后定义以免import时未定义。examples副本不另计，但generator正文属于可交付模板需保留。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Generated PHP union hydration and Python alias declaration order are clarified in shipped client-generator templates.

repository_updates.summary_zh: cover-letter/resume-tailor只用雇主术语的真实等价，不抄职位句子；提示注入警告放conversation/report不污染交付信，含近期3信和简历一致性；interview-coach分in-chat不读写workspace与saved经preflight，interviewing补async/AI screen的题量/时间/重试截止机制。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Application writing preserves factual vocabulary and cross-document consistency; interview prep separates in-chat and bound-workspace modes.

repository_updates.summary_zh: catalog query补CatalogClient须rerun://、rerun+https://或local rerun+http://，不可plain HTTPS；REDAP_TOKEN/auth stored token，segment URL拆ID。puffin条目仅函数例名apply_many→write_segment_manifest，不改分析方法。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Catalog guidance requires Rerun URL schemes and stored-token handling; the profiler edit changes only an example function name.

repository_updates.summary_zh: Hermes/插件变体独立审：不读/回显key、每render新文件名、删媒体需用户要求；Hermes补Seedream1–10refs/consentUrl，插件补FastH3 Omni R2V首选及doctor只安装升级/失败时用而非每次生成preflight。不是只因多分发path就跳过其有别的正文。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Hermes and plugin variants add credential/media safeguards, consent handoff and FastH3 reference-video routing with distinct doctor timing.

repository_updates.summary_zh: 新增kinematics/motion-planning/trajectory三公开lookup skills；都只读检索detail=execute拿固定interface/环境/准备argv，再按授权独立prepare，不直接机器人执行。分别核对joint/frame/rad/米/IK残差、map/obstacle/collision segment与smoothed路径、jerk/axis/control-period/terminal条件，velocity模式不保证目标position。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Adds three read-only discovery and preparation skills for kinematics, collision-aware planning and bounded trajectories; no hardware execution.

repository_updates.summary_zh: 包级指南同步1.0 required threadId/runContext、AG-UI RUN_FINISHED而非[DONE]、REASONING事件、body→forwardedProps、移除旧interrupt APIs/monolithic adapter；artifact blobKey必填，旧0.x需backfill。MCP新增harness plugin/OAuth connector/events webhook/raw HMAC/dedup；CredentialStore按tenant+user非thread、secret静态加密/不记录。media输入走generationParamsFromRequest并补多模态角色/expiry边界。docs维护默认tone不再审批，客户端镜像不增count。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Package guides migrate to 1.0 thread IDs, forwardedProps, terminal AG-UI events and required blob keys; add credential isolation and MCP Events.

repository_updates.summary_zh: 当前固定快照为96个叶指南与9个导航索引；新增21个公开叶指南，扩展GIS、AI、3D、IoT、演示与工具。现有CAD/GIS的API、安装、版本与许可范围说明有实质修订；完成静态复审，未运行上游代码。 静态复核标出Dify浏览器app-key暴露方案及PROJ轴序示例自相矛盾两项文本风险，按带提示的参考索引保留，不当作已验证生产方案。
repository_updates.summary_addition_en: Current fixed snapshot documents 96 leaf guides plus 9 navigation indexes, adding 21 public leaf guides across geospatial, AI, 3D, IoT, demos, and tooling. Existing CAD/GIS API, installation, version, and licensing-scope explanations are revised; guides were statically reviewed without executing upstream code. Static review flags a Dify browser app-key exposure pattern and a contradictory PROJ coordinate-axis example; retain these as cautioned references rather than verified production recipes.

findings.summary_zh: 文档把Dify app key放VITE_配置，且浏览器直接以Bearer调用Dify；.env.local不提交不能让密钥对浏览器保密。目录应标演示/需服务器密钥转发或等价受控架构，不能宣传该示例已具生产密钥隔离。此结论来自所审文本明确数据流，未测外部Dify权限。
同文解释EPSG:4326 authority为纬度在前，末尾验证示例却把116.391放第一位传cs2cs EPSG:4326；按自身轴序说明这会把116.391当纬度。需核对axis-order示例或显式调整顺序，不能将该示例当已验证正确数值。未执行PROJ。
